column2: Swing the sword wide and launch a black crescent of sword energy ahead
Leap and plant your sword in the ground. Black demon swords burst up tip-first in a line ahead
Gather flame on both swords for 1s, then cross them to launch a giant X of sword energy ahead
Ultimate Art. A vortex of black fire opens in the sky and rains flaming swords on nearby enemies for 2.4s, then a giant demon sword slams into the center as demon swords rise all around
: Apex forms only for Mythic-tier styles and above

You want to surpass the plum blossom? Then watch the flowers fall to the end. Stand until they bloom and fall three times, and this fan is yours.
You've died three times and lived three times. Still not enough. Endure my twilight to the end. If you can stand in the moment between sunset and moonrise, the Apex is yours.
I may look drunk, but my feet have never missed a step. Endure this stagger to the end and this bottle is yours.
You hold the Blood Demon's hand? Those nails are still short. Stand before my scythe to the end, and I'll hand it over.
A forest isn't something you knock down. It's something that endures. Stand to the end among my bamboo spears and leaves, and I'll teach you the fist of the trees.
Knowing how to raise a wave doesn't make you the sea. Keep breathing in the middle of my sea to the end, and I'll teach you the whale's song.
You know how to erase a blank. But how about drawing coordinates in one? Stand to the end inside my grid. Legs that crossed the crumbling stones should hold up.
They say the road to the afterlife is longer the more you hurry. I walked it faster than anyone. Keep up with my speed with your eyes, and I'll teach you that stride.
Even in a dream you must keep hold of your mind. Stay awake to the end of my dream path and I'll teach you that walk. Wounds taken in dreams still hurt.
Holding a star doesn't mean you command stars. Stand to the end under my dome of stars, and I'll hang the star at this staff's tip on you.
Holding lightning doesn't make you lightning. Take three of my bolts and still stand, and I'll fasten these bracers on your arms.
Small moons fall on six nearby enemies and burst into pillars of cold moonlight
